title: Market range: The Fed's rate is 4.75% after April: three more rises
html:
Market range

8.0%–75.0%

The Fed's rate is 4.75% after April: three more rises

Lower bound8.0%

What sets the lower bound

  1. YES bid on “Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.50% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?”, for “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting”: 21.0%
  2. YES bid on “Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.75% following the Fed's Apr 28, 2027 meeting?”, for “The Fed's rate is 5.00% or higher after April: a rise at every meeting, or a half-point step”: 10.0%
  3. “The Fed's rate is 5.00% or higher after April: a rise at every meeting, or a half-point step” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out
  4. “The Fed's rate is 4.75% after April: three more rises” is one way “The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting” can turn out

What sets the upper bound
